newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar suffers setback on poor demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar suffers setback on poor demand.

text.p: Sugar prices suffered a setback at the improved level on the local market, dealers said.
Sluggish consumer demand and fresh arrivals triggered profit-taking by stockists.

Last week arrivals were low as most delivery tenders of the free sale quota of the first half of the current month were complete but delivery for the second half has now commenced and traders are witnessing fresh arrivals, one broker said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 10 rupees at 1,270/1,325 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved down by 5/25 rupees to 1,295/1,380 rupees per quintal.
Sugar mill delivery slid five rupees at 1,205/1,220 rupees per quintal amid slow outstation buying, while millers turned active sellers, faced with tight money conditions.
Overall sentiment was subdued at the close of the session.
